controles.affirmation: Redressement fiscal americain de 1,3 Md$ que la societe reconnait sous-provisionne de plus d'1 Md$
controles.verbatim_source: the Company received a Notice of Proposed Adjustment ("NOPA") from the IRS which proposed an increase to the Company's U.S. taxable income that could result in additional income tax expense and cash liability of $1.3 billion, plus penalties and interest, which exceeds the current reserve recorded in its consolidated financial statements by more than $1.0 billion

controles.affirmation: Avis formel de redressement en mai 2024, Cour fiscale americaine depuis juillet 2024, appel envisage
controles.verbatim_source: In May 2024, the Company received a Statutory Notice of Deficiency ... claimed that the Company owes $1.3 billion in tax, plus penalties and interest ... In July 2024, the Company petitioned the U.S. Tax Court for redetermination, and if necessary, the Company will appeal

controles.affirmation: Amende espagnole de 110 M EUR ramenee a 65 M EUR (76 M$), caution de 70 M EUR (80 M$) en mai 2026
controles.verbatim_source: In July 2025, Airbnb received a letter from the Spanish Ministry of Consumer Affairs proposing to assess a fine of approximately 110 million Euro ($129 million) ... In September 2025 ... reduced the fine to approximately 65 million Euro ($76 million) ... In May 2026 ... a surety bond in the amount of 70 million Euro ($80 million) to suspend enforcement
